props.heading: An hour that's actually yours
props.sub: Hair, skin and body treatments in an unhurried studio — with a consultation before every service, so you leave with what you asked for.

props.label: The Studio
props.heading: Unhurried, and properly consulted
props.body:
We keep the chair count low on purpose. Fewer clients at a time means nobody is left sitting with colour on while their stylist runs to another head.

Every service starts with a short consultation — what you want, what your hair or skin will actually do, and what it takes to keep it up at home. If we think something will not suit you, we will say so before we start, not after.

We use professional, cruelty-free product lines throughout, and we patch-test all colour and chemical services 48 hours ahead.

pillars.title: Consultation first
pillars.text: Ten minutes before every service, so expectations match the result.

pillars.title: Patch-tested
pillars.text: All colour and chemical work is patch-tested 48 hours in advance.

pillars.title: Cruelty-free
pillars.text: Professional product lines, none of them animal tested.

pillars.title: Two weeks' aftercare
pillars.text: Any adjustment within a fortnight of a service is free.

props.label: Treatment Menu
props.heading: What we do
props.sub: Prices are a starting point — hair length, density and product use can change them. We confirm the final cost at consultation, before we begin.

items.title: Cut, Wash & Blow-Dry
items.desc: Consultation, wash with a head massage, precision cut and a finished blow-dry.

items.title: Colour & Highlights
items.desc: Global colour, balayage or foil highlights, with a bond-protecting treatment included.

items.title: Hair Spa & Treatments
items.desc: Deep conditioning, scalp care and smoothing treatments for dry or chemically treated hair.

items.title: Facials & Skincare
items.desc: Cleansing, hydrating and brightening facials, matched to your skin at consultation.

items.title: Threading & Waxing
items.desc: Brow shaping and threading, plus full waxing services using warm and cold wax.

items.title: Men's Grooming
items.desc: Cuts, fades, beard shaping and hot-towel shaves — walk-ins welcome on weekdays.

notes: Stylists are listed WITHOUT photographs — the Team section falls back to a clean initial avatar — so no real stock-photo face is captioned with an invented name; the salon should add its own team shots. Prices are written as starting points with durations, and the copy repeatedly says the final cost is confirmed at consultation, which is how salons actually quote and avoids implying a fixed rate. Patch-testing before colour is mentioned in three places on purpose: it is a genuine safety step and a real salon's site should say so.
